objects.source_content: A_O=((kappa+1)/2)I_n-((kappa-1)/4)(O+O^T); pi_A=N(0,A^-1). mu_(n,b) is Haar probability conditioned on det O=b. P_b is the mu_(n,b)-mixture of N(0,A_O^-1). p_O is the density of that actual Gaussian; p_b is the density of that actual single-block mixture. bar_pi_b is the D_b-averaged full target, identified by Eq6 with k independent P_b blocks and a residual standard Gaussian when present. bar_p_b is its density. a is the affinity integral of p_+1 and p_-1, not a freely supplied scalar.

domains.source_content: Finite Euclidean spaces R^d, R^n, and (only if kn<d) R^(d-kn); O belongs to the real orthogonal group O(n); b belongs to {-1,+1}; x_j belongs to R^n. The tuple (x_1,...,x_k,z) is the coordinate-block presentation of an actual point of R^d. Integration dx is ordinary Euclidean Lebesgue volume. The source fixes the Euclidean norm.

quantifiers.source_content: For the standing construction and each sign b, Eq70 gives the block formula for the density. Ex71 compares the two sign laws for the same n,d,k,kappa. The source does not quantify over arbitrary unrelated normalized functions in place of actual p_b or arbitrary laws in place of actual bar_pi_b. Ex72 concerns these same two full target mixtures.

assumptions.source_content: kappa>=4; 3<=n<=d; k=floor(d/n), hence k>=1 and kn<=d. Orthogonal blocks are independently sampled from the same conditioned Haar law for the fixed common determinant sign. Normalization/nonnegativity/measurability of p_b follow from being actual probability densities; residual normalization follows from the actual standard Gaussian. Eq6 is a prior proved/source identity consumed inside the density route, not a new convenience premise of the final source statement.

conclusion.source_content: Ex70: bar_p_b(x_1,...,x_k,z)=(product_j p_b(x_j))*phi_(d-kn)(z), with residual factor omitted when kn=d. Ex71: integral_R^d sqrt(bar_p_+1*bar_p_-1)=a^k. Ex72: TV(bar_pi_+1,bar_pi_-1)>=1-a^k>=1-exp(-(k/8)*exp(-10n/sqrt(kappa))). The Ex70 density identification is substantive even if downstream affinity/TV algebra is separately proved.

scopes_senses.source_content: All densities refer to their named actual laws and appropriate Euclidean volume. The paper writes a pointwise density formula after choosing densities; a formal a.e. density identification is valid measure semantics only if the representative convention and integral transport are explicit. Ex71 is a full-dimensional integral, not merely an integral on an unconnected abstract product carrier. Splitting coordinates may be volume-preserving without being an isometry for a default product/Pi maximum norm. The kn<d and kn=d cases are alternative exhaustive branches, not simultaneous premises. The source invokes Tonelli because the affinity integrand is nonnegative.

constant_dependencies.source_content: The density product and coordinate-volume identification introduce no free numerical constant or norm-equivalence factor. Affinity factorization is exactly a^k. The final exponent uses k/8 and -10n/sqrt(kappa), inherited from Eq25 and k-fold multiplication; residual dimension d-kn contributes unit mass only. No algorithmic T or epsilon enters Ex70-72.

source_proof_steps_expected.content: Identify actual Gaussian, conditioned Haar mixture, full averaged target, independent blocks, and the residual/no-residual branch.
Define single-block affinity and explain why independent blocks amplify separation.
Use normalization and Cauchy-Schwarz to obtain 0<=a<=1 and TV(P_+,P_-)<=sqrt(1-a^2).
Consume Proposition B7, square/rearrange with nonnegative quantities, then log(1-t)<=-t with its domain discharged.

From actual product law to product density in the named coordinate presentation, including actual Euclidean volume identification. This bridge is source-implied bookkeeping, not an additional source hypothesis.
Factor the square root of nonnegative product densities, invoke Tonelli across blocks, use residual standard Gaussian integral one, identify every block integral with a, obtain a^k.
When kn=d omit identity block and residual Gaussian factor; obtain the same affinity equality on R^d. This is an OR-case route together with kn<d.
Actual normalized full densities give TV=1-integral min; nonnegativity permits min<=sqrt(product); invoke Ex71 to obtain TV>=1-a^k.
Use Eq25 with nonnegative a, natural k and exponential power arithmetic to obtain the exact full-target separation in Lemma3.3/Eq8 and B5/Eq14.

residual_guards_expected.requirement: p_O must denote a density of N(0,A_O^-1); p_b must denote a density of the actual conditioned-Haar Gaussian mixture P_b. An arbitrary normalized function theorem alone does not close this identification.
The represented full density must connect to the actual D_b average bar_pi_b, via Eq6 or an explicitly equivalent source route; a density on an unrelated product measure is insufficient.

The flattened/split coordinate map must transport the product Euclidean volumes to R^d volume. Do not infer Euclidean isometry from a Pi/product carrier with its default maximum norm. A measurable/linear coordinate equivalence plus exact volume preservation suffices.

3<=n<=d and k=floor(d/n) discharge kn<=d; split kn<d versus kn=d. An omitted or conventionally zero-dimensional residual may be used only with explicit equivalence to the source's omitted factor, and no unexplained kn<d public restriction.
If the formal density is an a.e. representative, distinguish a.e. equality from the paper's displayed chosen pointwise formula and prove that all affinity/TV integrals use compatible representatives.

Nonnegativity and measurability of each actual factor discharge Tonelli; residual normalization and each p_b normalization must be proved internally from the law construction rather than supplied as excess final premises.
TV=min-overlap identity uses probability normalization and densities relative to the same full-space volume; min<=sqrt requires nonnegative factors.
Cauchy-Schwarz normalization, a>=0, a<=1, positive kappa and the log(1-t) domain are discharged in the predecessor route; final natural-power monotonicity and exp arithmetic preserve exact constants.

Every substantive B2.3 paragraph/display and reused source input has NODE or explicit EXCLUDED disposition, with prerequisite-to-consumer use sites. Full-root trace must preserve OR dimension branches and independent sufficient routes, never merge them into a false AND.
